reviews.review: furry borderlands, if that sounds good to you than give this a shot
I love this game, both solo, and with friends. It can be both very relaxing, and very stressful, depending on how seriously you want to play.

I have been trying for a while to play this game and like it. I really want to enjoy this game. I can see the potential in it, but no matter how hard i try it just isn't very good. The game is built like it's both built around a game with lots of movement options where you are supposed to dodge instead of tank hits, and a game where you have to tank through a lot of little hits and kill the enemy before they kill you. The problem is you don't have enough movement options to dodge everything and almost every enemy hits like a truck so it's the worst of both mixed into one. 
The weapons are one of the most mixed bags i've ever had to play with. most are overwhelmingly average quite a few are bad and there are maybe 5 good ones. Then there's the problem of damage. You have to get so lucky to get just the right items that let you do significant amounts of damage, and even then it might not matter cause all it takes is an enemy or boss that you can't run from cause your so slow dealing 100 damage and whoops runs over.
The stages are unbearably repetitive to play through. all it takes is two or three runs through an area and you already get tired of it.there are no memorable landmarks or special events that mix up the runs in any significant ways. the vaults are all the same do one of three obstacle courses fight a beefy enemy and thats it. And it doesn't help that you're so painfully slow. if you were just fifty percent faster i think most of my problems with this game would go away easily. you could dodge more you can get through floors faster it would be much more enjoyable.
It genuinely upsets me that i don't like this game but it just has to many problems for me to ignore.
